_source: Captured 2026-06-02 from a maintainer S7 Flashdry, dirty/waste water tank FULL state, during a transition test (c:/Temp/latest-4.txt log line 446). gci payload values are real; device metadata matches the known S7 Flashdry shape. PII (did/email/tokens) scrubbed.
_regression_note: Real transition: dirty tank not full = e2=0; dirty tank FULL = e2=256 (this fixture). e2 is a bitmask: bit 256 = waste/dirty tank full, bit 64 = fresh/clean tank empty. The waste water tank sensor must report 'full' here. It previously only checked e1/e3 (both 0) and short-circuited to 'clean'.
